title: Great construction, but very narrow width.
text:
Great construction, but very narrow width.. The bottle itself is very sleek and smooth. I've used it a few times so far and it has held up my drinks nicely while having a nice plastic filter that prevents the liquid from spill out too much when drinking.
The top is pretty easy to screw on and off, though I wish they didn't etch that logo and text on it. Seems gaudy.

The only thing is that it's ridiculously narrow. Even our bottle brush has a hard time fitting fully inside it, and none of our spoons are thin enough to go in and mix ingredients.

Great machinery, but the etching and width really drive it down a bit.
